notes.title: Controller support
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] You can now play with Xbox controller or PS5 dualsense
[*] You can now move the scout with both WASD and arrow keys
[*] Bug with language selector option fixed
[*] Bug with white great lisper strange behaviour fixed
[*] Bug with saw not hitting the worm fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Ocelot Sunrise Content Calendar Roadmap!
notes.notes:
At [b]Costa Blanca Studios[/b], we are incredibly proud of the open relationship we are fostering with our community.

We actively listen to your constructive feedback and work diligently to deliver what we believe, collectively, will elevate [b]Ocelot Sunrise[/b] even further. Every addition to the game is a labor of love, as we strive to push both Ocelot and the survivors' genre boundaries.

To continue building this relationship of trust and transparency, we are happy to announce the [b]Content Calendar Roadmap[/b] for [b]Ocelot Sunrise[/b]. This is the first one we will release, with more to come as we progress further into our journey towards 1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185897/2c4f0ca16df8cf7a8e77be73b206dbf887cae804.png[/img]
Thank you all for the feedback and valuable suggestions! Your help truly improves our game, and we will do our best to meet your expectations!

notes.title: Dive into Ocelot Sunrise with SharkyGaming at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Join us this Steam Next Fest October 2023 for an electrifying gameplay session of Ocelot Sunrise, piloted by the phenomenal SharkyGaming! 

While Sharky navigates through the breathtaking landscapes and challenges, our dedicated dev team will be live in the text chat, ready to field your questions and share insights about the game's universe. 

Don’t miss this chance to explore Ocelot Sunrise's thrilling realms, get answers straight from the creators, and engage with the community. 

Mark your calendars and be part of this exciting rendezvous in the vibrant world of Ocelot Sunrise!
